_doc: Foreground-clutter sweep (trailer unit, r5). The three showcase segments that filmed under a skybridge -- g2_assault, g3_jump and g7_melee -- are re-placed from this: probe_clear.gd reports, per bearing and lens height, how much of the frame is scenery within 70 m of the lens and what the nearest piece is. A bearing with near=0.00 films clear sky over open deck. Spawns are the ones those three takes actually use.

stages.note: the showcase stage; g7_melee and g5_dodge fight here
g3_jump's spawn -- the deck the jump take uses
g2_assault's arena mark -- the ram lane
